calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity, cp.category, cp.subcategory, p.sku, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.subcategory,
  count(*) lines, round(sum(net_amount),2) sold_net, round(sum(r.refund_net),2) refunded_net,
  round(100*sum(r.refund_net)/sum(net_amount),2) rate_pct,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_refund,
  sum(CASE WHEN r.quantity_returned > quantity THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) over_qty,
  sum(CASE WHEN net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos,
  sum(CASE WHEN store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) web_lines
FROM sold cp LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = cp.sales_line_id
WHERE cp.category='Garden'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, sold.subcategory,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.refund_net) / SUM(sold.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON r.sales_line_id = sold.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sold.subcategory ORDER BY sold.subcategory
